name: Nova
author: Loungepad
description: A console home screen: your recent games as square icons over full-screen art, and under them the game hub -- Play, achievement, stats and mods cards, activities, media and the game info -- with a game library of Installed and Your Collection beside it.

settings.name: Library tiles across
settings.hint: How many squares fit in a row of the game library. Fewer are larger

settings.name: Names on every square
settings.hint: Every square in the game library shows its name. Off, only the one under the highlight does

settings.name: Activities on the home screen
settings.hint: The highlighted game's achievements, earned and not, under its cards

settings.name: Media on the home screen
settings.hint: The highlighted game's trailers and screenshots, under its activities
